title: terragucci.state-versions/v1
description: states.json in a project's directory of a reports prefix: for each root, where its state is, whether its backend keeps versions, and the version ids its tf-apply waves left, newest first. Version ids, never a state's contents. Within v1 fields are only added, and an existing field never changes meaning.

backend.description: The backend the root initialised: s3, local, gcs and so on.

location.description: s3://<bucket>/<key>, or the local file's path in the root.

versioning.description: As the newest apply found it.

note.description: Why the version could not be read, or what off means for this backend.

checked.description: When the newest apply that recorded the root finished.

finished.description: When the wave that recorded the version finished.

path.description: The wave's run directory, relative to the project's index.json.
